FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 325
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Corey Harbison
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/28/2023
House Bill 325 as introduced would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund and local funds by a small, undetermined amount by exempting any food pantry in
Cullman County from paying state, county, and municipal sales and use taxes.
